dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 12 to 15 high-luminance circular blobs are visible, arranged in three distinct horizontal rows following the curvature of the fin. The spots exhibit a regular spatial distribution with consistent inter-blob distance along the vertical axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss and irregular jagged serration along the entire posterior margin. A prominent, high-intensity linear white mark (likely a healed scar or lesion) bisects the fin surface diagonally from the upper leading edge toward the lower trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two distinct fish silhouettes (remoras) positioned near the ventral and posterior margins of the fin.
